Buildings Collapse in Pune and Delhi Amid Heavy Rain, People Feared Trapped

Multiple building collapses have been reported in India, with incidents in Pune and Delhi occurring amidst heavy rainfall. In Pune's Pimpri Chinchwad area, a building at a waste-to-energy project collapsed, trapping an estimated 15-20 workers. Another building collapse was reported in Delhi's Rohini area. Rescue operations are underway in Pune, with authorities investigating the causes, including potential impacts from heavy rains and waste mound collapses.
